name: Fire extinguishers

comps.spec: Water extinguisher: about 9-litre stainless tank with a Schrader valve — refill and pump up with a bike pump (stay in the green on the gauge); makes a pressure sprayer or camp shower
comps.loc: Silver extinguishers in schools and offices

comps.spec: CO2 extinguisher cylinder, liquid CO2 at about 55 bar (800 psi) — never drill, cut or heat it
comps.loc: Wall brackets and cabinets (black horn nozzle)

comps.spec: Squeeze valve (with a pressure gauge on stored-pressure types)

notes: Keep working ones charged and close at hand: with no fire service, a small fire is a disaster. Dry-powder units irritate the lungs when discharged and are less useful to strip.
